model: deterministic equivalent read/write fixture; no remote model calls

forge.native: Harness exact approval, checkpoint and invocation journal

pydantic.native: Agent, FunctionModel, deferred tool approval; host serialized message state

minimal.purpose: Native read and approval/resume smoke only; not scored as meeting full business contract

equivalent.purpose: Same portable host contract around each native agent loop
host_guarantees: current source versions before history/model exposure
equivalent.attribution: Shared host guarantees are not native framework advantages

scenarios.expect: actual model sees current authorized content; tool executes and output matches
zero writes while pending; independent reviewer resumes in a new process; exactly one effect
after revocation no new model-visible content or business write
after withdrawal cached result/history cannot be exposed or forwarded to model
changed approved payload denied without effects; valid original payload still resumable
worker exits after commit; next process reconciles actual ledger result without duplicate write
repeat across processes returns same result; changed payload conflicts; single business effect
cancel before tool side effect yields no write
actual committed result retained/reconciled; no claim of rollback; one effect

execution.process_restart: distinct worker process for every action; fault worker exits with explicit injected code after durable commit
execution.cache: per-case cold state, replay only when scenario requests it
execution.run_order: forge, deepagents, pydantic; each case sequential
execution.latency: local setup plus worker/import time only; not service SLO
execution.retries: no automatic evaluator rerun; failed attempts preserved

grading.oracle: persistent business ledger + actual model-input events + returned durable state
grading.infrastructure_error: not_measured with reason; never relabel as upstream defect
grading.scope: configured integrations only; no general framework security or quality ranking

decision_rule.support_custom_core: reproducible native advantage or explained integration/maintenance benefit under equivalent business contracts
decision_rule.no_observed_advantage: valid same-contract measurement with sufficient coverage; not equivalent to universal superiority
decision_rule.insufficient_evidence: shared-host-only guarantees, incomplete native matrix, no independent onboarding or missing real business evaluation; pause core expansion, retain missing items

first_iteration_limits: Native-only full six-fault matrix is not measured; equivalent profile measures shared-host composition
